scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run build:assembler && npm run dev -w @mips-quest/web
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:assembler && npm run build -w @mips-quest/web
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run build:assembler && node --test packages/mips-core/tests/*.test.mjs packages/mips-assembler/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mips-quest/mips-core && npm run typecheck -w @mips-quest/mips-assembler && npm run typecheck -w @mips-quest/web
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run typecheck
